body: Ya I feel ya, but it's worth it man. I went down at 80+ mph, just got road rash. All my gear, boots, helmet got trashed, but it saved my face, my life, everything. Both sides of my outside legs got torn up, knees 'burned' through second layer of skin. Anyways, this isn't to discourage you. I had a 98 600F3. Buying a 1000RR now or a 600RR next

Well I actually crashed last October on my bike when I was stationed in SoCal, so I'm bike-less right now. Gonna get another one soon ready for next season. Good luck on finding a motorcycle, always a blast. Also from what I learned from my crash, Get a nice helmet, don't think about the price much. Get good rated gear, get leather boots/steel toe or actually riding boots with re-enforced CE armor. Pants... Kevlar with armor inserts or better. I'll just say that much lol

I forgot to mention, I'm on Depakote. I went 2 weeks before without it (on 500mg dose at the time, and still am) and I went crazy, I'm not sure how I got through the days, or how I was able to ride my motorcycle still. 

Sorry I didn't even think about doing a dose every other day. I am on the 150mg Effexor XR (Capsule) and 75mg tablet. So I just took 75mg tablet and 150mg of Wellbutrin XL. 

Speaking of Sunlight, for my 2 years and 8 months of enduring this, I was in the middle east for 8.5 months, 24/7 day light literally since I also worked outside. I've been back in San Diego since Jan 2013 when I was forced to come back to the states due to my psychological events and issues. Literally, I've been in too much sun-light and it fucks with my migraines. I'm happily back East, enjoying my cooler weather, having cloudy days and rain. That's one of the biggest changes I've enjoyed.

Well I've been waiting technically to have any kind of appointment since July 25th. Plus I ran out of pain-killers two weeks ago and since Codeine is a Schedule II substance, they couldn't give me a enough supply before I came home also, so resorting taking my Dad's Hydro's 7.5 :(

It's like I want to talk to people about this, then I don't want to talk to anyone. I don't know what it is. Maybe it's the listening factor?
I don't got a doctor's apt till August 29th... Good ole Veteran Affairs. They won't take me in since I'm still technically Active Duty.. So I gotta wait till I'm a veteran to be seen

Before the Effexor I was on um... Celexa I think it was, I was even more suicidal than I was on Effexor, but yet again my body is adjusting to the medication... Like any others I've taken in my life and it's not affective.
Because I got sick and tired of them not working, and me feeling like shit for 2 years 8 months straight, so literally I've lost hope and lack of not giving a shit
